text.description_html:
Michael Healy MH1151, 6 Inch Blue Crab Door Knocker in Polished Brass with Brown Patina

The Large Brass and Brown Crab Door Knocker is 6 inches tall and 7 inches wide. It is made out of sandcast brass and is finished in Polished Brass with Brown Patina. The Blue Crab Front Door Knocker is great for beach houses all over the Eastern Coast or if you just want to bring a bit of the ocean to your land-locked abode.

Each door knocker is beautifully packed and is signed and dated by the artist, Michael Healy.

Available in 3 finishes:
Polished Brass and Brown Patina Nickel Silver Oiled Bronze

Features and Specifications of the Blue Crab Front Door Knocker:

  • Material: Sandcast Brass
  • Finish: Polished Brass and Brown Patina
  • Height: 6"
  • Width: 7"
  • Mounting Hole Centers: 1-3/8"
  • Projection Off Door: 2-1/4"
  • Mounting: Surface Mounting
  • Comes packaged with mounting hardware.

Sold Individually
